name: Discord call
description: Your current Discord voice call: its length on the pill, channel and participants on hover, and mic, deafen, camera and leave controls when expanded.

emits.discord.join: You joined a voice channel or call (channel, guild, kind)
emits.discord.voice: Your mic or deafen state changed (mute, deaf)

options.label: Application ID
options.description: From a free app you create at discord.com/developers/applications (see the README, Discord call). Discord only lets an app control your client.

options.label: Client secret
options.description: The app's OAuth2 client secret. Stored in config.json as plain text.

options.label: Redirect URI
options.description: Must be listed under OAuth2 > Redirects in the app. Nothing is ever opened there.

options.label: Camera shortcut
options.description: Discord cannot switch the camera over its local API, so the island presses the key you bound to it in Discord (Settings > Keybinds), e.g. CTRL SHIFT, V. Empty hides the camera button.

options.label: Discord window class
options.description: Which window receives the camera shortcut: its class, as island-ctl windows shows it.
